WITH counts_by_hand AS (
  SELECT throws, COUNT(*) as award_count 
  FROM manager_award ma 
  INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id 
  GROUP BY throws
),
shares AS (
  SELECT throws, award_count, 
    CAST(award_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(award_count) FROM counts_by_hand) as share 
  FROM counts_by_hand
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT throws, award_count, share 
  FROM shares 
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(award_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
